segment_record.sort_key: same total order as unitigs.fasta and unitig_evidence.tsv

empty_graph: The file contains the literal H record plus LF and no S or L records.
constraints: All S records precede all L records.
Each S sequence and metadata agree byte-for-byte with its FASTA and evidence-table record.
The S sequence length equals edge_steps plus k minus one.
Every S record has edge_steps equal to canonical_kmers; one segment cannot consume a backing canonical key more than once.
Each L overlap is exactly k minus one bases.
Each oriented L suffix and prefix match for exactly the declared overlap.
A link and its reverse-complement representation are emitted once under the architecture's typed lexical canonicalization; hairpin and self-links remain.
Pair observations never create GFA links.
A separate streaming semantic read-back validator compares every ordered H, S, and L field with the typed graph data before commit.
